def mosaic(a, c=80, t=120):
    # four corner patches (c x c) upscaled to t x t and blended into a 224x224 bird-free "background-only" image
    H = 224; out = np.zeros((H, H, 3), np.float32); wsum = np.zeros((H, H, 1), np.float32)
    ramp = np.ones(t, np.float32); ov = 2*t - H  # overlap width
    r1 = ramp.copy(); r1[t-ov:] = np.linspace(1, 0, ov+2)[1:-1]   # fades out at inner edge
    for (ys, xs, oy, ox, fy, fx) in [(slice(0,c), slice(0,c), 0, 0, False, False), (slice(0,c), slice(H-c,H), 0, H-t, False, True),
                                     (slice(H-c,H), slice(0,c), H-t, 0, True, False), (slice(H-c,H), slice(H-c,H), H-t, H-t, True, True)]:
        p = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(a[ys, xs]).resize((t, t), Image.BICUBIC)).astype(np.float32)
        wy = r1[::-1] if fy else r1; wx = r1[::-1] if fx else r1
        wgt = (wy[:, None] * wx[None, :])[..., None]
        out[oy:oy+t, ox:ox+t] += p * wgt; wsum[oy:oy+t, ox:ox+t] += wgt
    return np.clip(out / np.maximum(wsum, 1e-6), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

def center_alpha(lo=32, feather=16):
    H = 224; r = np.zeros(H, np.float32)
    r[lo+feather:H-lo-feather] = 1
    r[lo:lo+feather] = np.linspace(0, 1, feather+2)[1:-1]; r[H-lo-feather:H-lo] = np.linspace(1, 0, feather+2)[1:-1]
    return (r[:, None] * r[None, :])[..., None]

# Hypothesis: 64px corner patches mirror-tiled give mostly bird-free, natural-texture background-only images.
def mosaic2(a, c=64):
    H = 224; h = H//2; out = np.zeros((H, H, 3), np.uint8)
    def tile(p):  # p is c x c with its OUTER corner at top-left; returns h x h reflect-tiled, outer corner at top-left
        row = np.concatenate([p, p[:, ::-1]], axis=1); full = np.concatenate([row, row[::-1]], axis=0)
        return full[:h, :h]
    tl = a[:c, :c]; tr = a[:c, H-c:][:, ::-1]; bl = a[H-c:, :c][::-1]; br = a[H-c:, H-c:][::-1, ::-1]
    out[:h, :h] = tile(tl); out[:h, h:] = tile(tr)[:, ::-1]; out[h:, :h] = tile(bl)[::-1]; out[h:, h:] = tile(br)[::-1, ::-1]
    return out
